SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

No. D 4870
S.2. Special Branch Station,
Date 19 / 5 / 1933
Date May 19th 1933.

Subject (in full) Mrs. M.L. Rojdestvensky.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the letter dated May 11, 1933 from
the Netherlands Consulate-General regarding Mrs. M.L.Rojdestvensky
nee Margerite Baginsky, enquiries show that she is a Russian born
at Warsaw on September 29, 1901. She is a daughter of one Braginsky
an officer of the Russian Imperial Army, and was married to one
Colonel Rojdestvensky, an ex-Cavalry officer. She escaped with
her husband from Vladivostok in 1920 after the defeat of White
Russian Army. From 1920 till 1928 Mrs Rojdestvensky resided in
Harbin, Tientsin and in Tsinaufu. In 1925/6 her husband joined
Marshal Chang Chung Chang's Army and at about that time she
secured a separation from him. In 1928 Mrs. Rojdestvensky arrived
in Shanghai from Harbin and was employed as a manicurist and also
had other casual work. During 1931/2 she worked as a manicurist
at "The Shanghai Club Parlour", 5 Central Road. She resides at
present at No.475 Rue August Boppe the boarding house of one
Mrs. Zaitzeff.

She is not known to be connected or interested in
any political activities and nothing is known in Municipal Police
records to her detriment.

Dr. Y. Riabin who issued the medial certificate to
Mrs. Rojdestvensky is a well known doctor among the local Russian
Community. He is a Yugoslavian (Serbian) subject, who resided
for many years in Russia. Dr. Riabin participated in the Civil
War in Siberia being a Sergeant in the White Russian Army. He is
registered with the Shanghai Municipal Council as a doctor. No-
thing is known in Municipal Police records to his detriment.

[Signature]
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

（左侧批注：）
Mr Yao,
usual
reply please
[Signature]
MAY 1st 1933

日期 1933年5月19日。

主题（全称） M.L. Rojdestvensky 夫人。

由 D.S. Tcheremshansky 撰写。由 [签名] 转呈

关于荷兰总领事馆1933年5月11日就 M.L. Rojdestvensky 夫人（婚前姓 Margerite Baginsky）一事所发信函，经查询，她系俄罗斯人，1901年9月29日出生于华沙。她是俄国帝国陆军军官 Braginsky（音译）之女，嫁予前骑兵军官 Rojdestvensky 上校。1920年白俄军队战败后，她与丈夫从海参崴逃脱。1920年至1928年间，Rojdestvensky 夫人居住在哈尔滨、天津和济南（Tsinaufu）。1925/6年左右，其丈夫加入张宗昌元帅的部队，约在此时，她与其分居。1928年，Rojdestvensky 夫人从哈尔滨抵达上海，受雇为美甲师，亦从事其他零散工作。1931/2年间，她在中央路5号“上海俱乐部美容室”（The Shanghai Club Parlour）担任美甲师。她目前居住在奥古斯特·博佩路（Rue August Boppe）475号 Zaitzeff 夫人经营的寄宿公寓。

据知，她未参与或对任何政治活动感兴趣，且在工部局警务档案中并无对其不利的记录。

向 Rojdestvensky 夫人出具医疗证明的 Y. Riabin 博士是当地俄裔社群中知名的医生。他是南斯拉夫（塞尔维亚）籍臣民，曾在俄罗斯居住多年。Riabin 博士曾以白俄军队中士身份参加西伯利亚内战。他已在上海公共租界工部局注册为医生。工部局警务档案中并无对其不利的记录。

[签名]
D. S.
特别股主管警官。

（左侧批注：）
姚先生，
请按惯例回复
[签名]
1933年5月1日

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No. 1358.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. S. S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 4870
Date 12 / 5 / 33

SHANGHAI, 11th May 1933.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Mrs. M. Rojdestvensky, née Marguerite Baginsky, born at Warsaw, 29 September 1901, living at 3 Tracey Terrace, holding passport No. 1541, issued by the local Bureau of Public Safety on 6 May 1933, desires to proceed to Netherlands India for the purpose of recuperating her health.

She showed me a certificate issued by Dr. J. Y. Ryabine of 49 Nanking Road to the effect that she needed a change of climate.

Her husband is stated to be living at Tientsin.

I would be much obliged to hear from you whether anything is known against her, or against Dr. Ryabine, either from a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

[Signature]
Chinese Secretary.

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

D. S. Wloremchansky.
DSR 175.

Sd, For attention please.
[Initials]
May 11 1933

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事、特别股登记处
编号 D 4870
日期 33年5月12日

上海，1933年5月11日。

先生：

谨此告知，M. Rojdestvensky 夫人（婚前姓 Marguerite Baginsky），1901年9月29日出生于华沙，现居 Tracey Terrace 3号，持有1933年5月6日由本地公安局签发的第1541号护照，拟前往荷属东印度以休养健康。

她向我出示了南京路49号 J. Y. Ryabine 医生开具的证明，称其需要改变气候环境。

据称其丈夫居住在天津。

如蒙告知是否有关于她或 Ryabine 博士在政治或道德方面的不利记录，不胜感激。

顺致
崇高的敬意，
先生，
您恭顺的仆人，

[签名]
华务秘书。

T. P. Givens 先生，
特别股主管警官，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

D. S. Wloremchansky。
DSR 175。

Sd, 请予关注。
[首字母缩写]
1933年5月11日
